entities.name: Teeth of Akoum
entities.description: A treacherous, jagged mountain range in northern Akoum on Zendikar.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane on which Akoum lies.

entities.name: Affa
entities.description: The largest settlement in the Teeth, at the mountain base, mostly human, with a bazaar as trading hub.

entities.name: Affa Inn
entities.description: Inn in Affa run by Hion, home to the Names of the Lost Travelers.

entities.name: Akoum Expeditionary House
entities.description: A center for explorers and adventurers in Affa.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: A secret ancient cavern deep in the Teeth that once served as the prison of the Eldrazi titans.

entities.name: League of Anowon Camp
entities.description: A secluded training camp for elite explorers founded by the vampire scholar Anowon.

entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: Vampire scholar who founded the League of Anowon camp.

entities.name: Spikefields
entities.description: A hazardous zone covered in sharp, jagged stones.

entities.name: Windblast Gorge
entities.description: A perilous mountain pass frequented by aggressive drakes, carved by the Eldrazi Zhulodok.

entities.name: Zhulodok
entities.description: A monstrous Eldrazi that carved Windblast Gorge as it passed through the mountains.

entities.name: Eldrazi titans
entities.description: Ancient titans once imprisoned at the Eye of Ugin.

events.summary: Zhulodok carved Windblast Gorge as it passed through the mountains.
events.quote: The gorge was originally carved by the monstrous Eldrazi Zhulodok as it passed through the mountains.

relations.quote: is a treacherous mountain range in northern Akoum on the plane of Zendikar
